{{Top|leg}}
A '''fang eel''' was a type of [[Eel/Legends|eel]]. In [[45 ABY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Suuas]] was caught by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] at the<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref> [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> supply depot [[Crossing Lanes Station]] while using an [[eavesdropping saucer]] [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]] to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the pair and, when found out, Suuas looked at the listening device as if it were a fang eel.<ref name="Crucible" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fang eels were referenced in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
